hook.name: IpStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to an IpStrategyFactory contract. After each swap, it takes a 2.5% fee from the output token, converts non-ETH fees to ETH via a nested pool swap, then distributes the ETH to the strategy's NFT vault, owner, and platform through the factory.
